entries.subject: North Central Health Care (CCN 524017) - machine-readable file last_updated_on date
entries.body:
Hello,

Hope you're doing well! I took a look at your hospital price transparency files and I wanted to flag something on North Central Health Care's machine-readable file.

The file is up and loading fine with no access issues. However, the `last_updated_on` value in it reads 2024-01-19, which as of today is 952 days ago (about 2 years, 7 months).

A few details in case they're useful:

* CCN: 524017
* Pointer file: https://www.norcen.org/cms-hpt.txt
* MRF: https://machine-readable-files.com/north-central-health-care/930801810_North-Central-Health-Care_standardcharges.csv
* CMS template version: 2.0.0
* Checked: 08/27/2026 6:18 PM EST

For reference, 45 CFR 180.50(b)(2) requires hospitals to update the standard charge file at least once annually and to indicate the date of the last update. Going by the January 2024 date, the annual refresh would have been due 01/19/2025, so it's currently about 19 months past that point, with two annual cycles in between.

Is a refresh already in the works or has the file perhaps been republished somewhere else that the pointer file hasn't caught up with? Happy to correct my records if I'm looking at the wrong copy.

I'll plan to check back around September 27 to see how things are going. Wanted to be upfront that if the file still shows a January 2024 date at that point, I'll likely need to flag the annual-update requirement to CMS.

Thanks so much and let me know if I've got the wrong copy of the file or if there's anything else I can pass along.

Best,
Anthony
m***@anthonyisnota.dev

entries.subject: Wrangell Medical Center standard charges file - format and cms-hpt.txt
entries.body:
Hello,

I'm doing some research into hospital price transparency compliance and had a couple of notes on SEARHC Wrangell Medical Center's machine-readable standard charges file.

The file linked from your Billing & Financing page is published as an Excel spreadsheet:

https://searhc.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Wrangell-Medical-Center-Standard-Charges.xlsx

The data itself already follows the CMS template, but CMS asks for the machine-readable file to be a .csv or .json rather than .xlsx for compliance. Re-saving the same sheet as CSV should cover that easily.

I also couldn't find a cms-hpt.txt file at https://searhc.org/cms-hpt.txt, which currently returns a 404. That's the text file CMS asks hospitals to place at the root of the website so the charges file can be found automatically.

The same two things apply to the Mt. Edgecumbe Medical Center file on that page, if it's handled by the same team.

I'll plan to follow up in about 30 days so I can keep my research moving, but would appreciate it if these could be sorted out before then. Happy to help however's useful.


Thanks so much,

Anthony
m***@anthonyisnota.dev
mrf.anthonyisnota.dev

correction.note: A standard-charges file exists and is publicly reachable, but it is not compliant. (1) Wrong format: it is served as .xlsx (https://searhc.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Wrangell-Medical-Center-Standard-Charges.xlsx). CMS 45 CFR 180.50 requires the machine-readable file be a .csv or .json conforming to the CMS template; .xlsx is not an accepted format. The file's content does follow the CMS template (version 2.0.0, valid 180.50 attestation, standard_charge|... columns, last_updated_on 2025-09-11), so this is a format/packaging failure rather than missing data. (2) No cms-hpt.txt: https://searhc.org/cms-hpt.txt returns 404, so there is no root pointer file as required since 2024-07-01. The file is linked (as 'Wrangell Medical Center Standard Charges') from the Billing & Financing page at https://searhc.org/patient-resources/billing-financing/, not from the homepage or footer, and /price-transparency/ 404s. The sibling SEARHC facility Mt. Edgecumbe Medical Center is published the same way (also .xlsx) on the same page.
